journey.name: Store Effective Access Panel
journey.description: Validates that support operators can view a store's subscription status, billing enforcement state, enforcement bypass reasons, and the full effective access breakdown (features, limits, and areas) on the merchant details page.

story.title: Merchant detail plan and effective access section
Billing enforcement status and bypass reason
Effective features, limits, and dashboard areas breakdown

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/merchants'.
Scroll to the 'Plan and Effective Access' card.
Verify the card displays the current plan name, billing interval, subscription status, and billing enforcement badge.
If billing enforcement is disabled, verify the banner displays the plain enforcement reason (e.g. override active or subscription exempt).
Verify the effective access breakdown tabs or groups display Features (included / not included), Limits (numeric cap or unlimited), and Dashboard Areas (none, view, or manage).
Verify the informational notice confirms that dashboard areas restrict dashboard operations only, not raw API calls.
